decision: **Crash frames are named in the cloud, and three guarded verbs replace recurring permission asks.** The DLL links with a GNU ld map (`-Wl,-Map`, no `--cref`), normalised so it is reproducible, with a sidecar `{dll, build_id, dll_sha256, image_base, size, size_of_image}`; `repro` proves the flag moves no byte of the DLL. CI keeps `proxy-map-<build id>` 90 days (render block `proxy_map`, upload-artifact pinned to a commit); a release attaches its own. `wsc crash symbolise` (standard library only) names the exception frame and labels stack words as scan candidates, never frames, and refuses a map whose sidecar disagrees with the log, the DLL or the dump. **Agents may run without asking:** `wsc crash symbolise` (reads files; writes only `_scratch/maps/`), `wsc agent-settings allow` and `remove` (only rules a `[agent_settings] safe` pattern covers, itself or extended by whole words without a write or run flag such as `--output` or `-c`, never under a `deny` (one with a `*` inside read broadly), never wildcards or shell operators, never a hook or `deny` entry, only the repo's own `<root>/.claude/*.json` with no symlink, junction or hard link on the way, atomic with a `.bak`; Liam's judgement is the safe list) and `job.sh vdisplay-aside` (moves, never deletes, a `vdisplay_restore.json` the watcher's own restore failed on or that is older than the stale limit, with the lock free or the caller's and no game running; it never writes the display mode). A new allowed command with reach, a merge right or a hook change stays Liam's. Raised by the 2026-11-03 audit (napoleon-remastered `docs/audits/AUDIT_2026-11-03.md`, automation 7).
